findings.message: act1/halt_waiting_shelter: the wood is lit from the right (luminance rises 6 L per H to the east)
findings.fix: light from the upper left: lit faces west and north, dark faces east and south

reviewer.note: blocker: the eave stands at 46 art px (1.06 m), against the size guide's rain-shelter eaves of 40 to 48 world px (120 to 144 art px); Bramble cannot stand under it. The roof is one flat slab with no fascia, gutter or thickness; the bench is mottle, not boards; the poster is a red glyph (docs/reviews/2026-11-04-act1-props.md)
